description: Structural rules for all compiled TypeScript schemas

rules.description: All exported Zod schemas must be named in PascalCase: UserSchema, CreateUserInputSchema
Every exported schema must have a corresponding type: export type User = z.infer<typeof UserSchema>
Never export z.object({}) directly — always assign to a named const first
rules.check: absence of 'export const X = z.object' with inline anonymous usage

rules.description: Schemas for POST/PUT body are named {Entity}InputSchema or Create{Entity}Schema
Schemas for PATCH body use .partial() or are named Update{Entity}Schema
Entity ID fields must be z.string().uuid() or z.string().cuid() — never z.number() without explicit justification
Date fields must be z.string().datetime() or z.date() — never z.string() alone
z.record(z.any()) and z.array(z.any()) are forbidden without a comment explaining why
rules.check: absence of z.record(z.any()) without justification comment
